verdicts.title: Extended Iterative Scheme for QCD: the Four-Gluon Vertex
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the self-consistency problem of the generalized Feynman rule ( nonperturbatively modified vertex of zeroth perturbative order ) for the 4-gluon vertex function in the framework of an extended perturbation scheme accounting for non-analytic coupling dependence through the Λ scale. Tensorial
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the 4-gluon vertex function in QCD and an extended perturbation scheme, which has no interaction with affine representations, minimal rank, or monotone circuit complexity for k-CLIQUE.
